Ce rôle couvre le placement de composants, le routage, la préparation des données de fabrication, la documentation sous contrôle de configuration ainsi que le soutien aux activités allant du prototype jusqu’à la production en série. Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise pratique de Cadence Allegro pour travailler sur des technologies PCB complexes et collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes d’ingénierie électrique, mécanique, qualité, fabrication et industrialisation afin de livrer des conceptions robustes, cohérentes et manufacturables. Générer, vérifier, mettre à jour et publier les dossiers de définition PCB/PCBA, les nomenclatures (BOM), les dessins techniques, les fichiers CAO ainsi que les données de fabrication et d’assemblage CAD/CAM. Capacité à gérer les priorités, respecter les échéances et travailler de façon autonome avec rigueur, sens des responsabilités et volonté d’amélioration continue. CompétencesSouhaitées Expérience en conception de circuits imprimés flexibles (Flex) et/ou rigides-flexibles (Rigid-Flex), ainsi que certification IPC Certified Interconnect Designer (CID). Expérience en testabilité et maintenabilité des PCB/PCBA, en résolution de problématiques avec les fabricants et partenaires d’assemblage, en soutien à la transition du prototype vers la production à grand volume, ainsi qu’en gestion de l’obsolescence des composants et des matériaux. Direct experience working with international programs in the HR arena, particularly within Latin America. Experience leading and managing a large team of HR professionals. Experience in conflict resolution techniques. Experience with leading projects and managing the work of others. Experience using MS Office software with experience in constructing and producing reports, presentations, data manipulation, and analysis. Ability to travel as needed both within the LA Region and internationally. Desired Qualifications Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience appreciated. High degree of cultural agility and intelligence with a demonstrated ability to integrate and adapt global HR strategies to local contexts in a culturally competent way. Between 10-15 years Senior level HR Generalist experience. Advanced degree in Human Resources Management or related discipline. SPHR, SHRM-SCP or equivalent professional certification or license as required by local labor law. Strong experience influencing without authority. Knowledge of Latin America labor laws. Experience in Workday HRIS. Excellent interpersonal skills and strong client service orientation. Excellent communication skills, written and verbal, with all levels of individuals. Ability to negotiate and deal effectively, tactfully, and honestly. A proven strategic thinker with sound technical skills, analytical ability, and good judgment. review_candidates.title: Cultural Mediator (Arabic), IPO
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates. Organizational Context and Scope IOM opened an office in Ireland in 2001. Ireland became a full member government of IOM in 2002. Since November 2022, IOM Ireland has been providing high-level cultural mediation support to International Protection Applicants (IPAs), assisting them in their application process for international protection. Through a team of cultural mediators operating at the Department of Justice’s International Protection Office (IPO) at Citywest and Mount St. in Dublin, IOM contributes to enhance access to asylum procedures in Ireland and to improve the capacity of the IPO to manage asylum applications efficiently. Responsibilities Provide cultural mediation and interpretation support to International Protection Applicants (IPAs) by providing information and facilitating communication with the International Protection Office (IPO) (from English into beneficiaries’ mother tongue and vice versa) during their international protection interview, always respecting the principles of neutrality, accuracy, impartiality, and confidentiality Provide administrative and linguistic support to IPAs during the various stages of their application for international protection. This could include, when needed, assistance in the completion of relevant forms; Contribute to identifying potential vulnerable cases and signs of exploitation among the beneficiaries assisted and to their onward referral to appropriate services in Ireland; Be available to travel from/to sites in the area of the assigned duty station as requested by the Project Management Team (PMT). Provide regular reporting as requested by the Project Management Team. Assist through interpretation in collection of information and data, case identification, and referrals; Assist the Project Management Team with the preparation of all relevant documentation, surveys, and statistics related to the project and regularly report to the PMT on the activities performed; Any other related task, as required. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education High school diploma with at least five years of relevant experience; or, University degree with at least three years of relevant professional experience. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience At least 2 years of experience in cultural mediation in the framework of migrants’ assistance. Previous experience with international organizations, NGOs, EU Agencies and/or Irish law enforcements or Government’s Departments would be an asset. Skills Ability to work with migrants and asylum seekers; Interpersonal skills (i.e. empathy and emotional resilience); Intercultural competence and communication skills; Culture-specific knowledge; Capacity to prevent and mitigate conflicts and bridge gaps due to language misunderstandings in an objective and impartial manner between the beneficiaries and the authorities. Psychological understanding in interpersonal communication and sensitiveness in addressing the asylum-seekers’ claims. Knowledge of the procedures related to the asylum application in Ireland. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; Ability to prepare clear and concise reports and work with statistics. Good experience with Microsoft Office. Languages All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish). For this position, fluency in English and Arabic is required (oral and written). Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Notes Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances. This post is subject to local recruitment. Only those holding a valid residence and work permit for the country where this position is based will be eligible for consideration. As the right to live and work in Ireland is required, the contract issued may be shorter that the period mentioned in the advertisement, in order to align with the expiry date of the work permit. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

review_candidates.description: ABOUT NEXUS FOR DEVELOPMENT Nexus for Development mobilises climate finance to accelerate the growth of climate positive enterprises across Southeast Asia, with a focus on carbon and debt financing. Founded in 2009, Nexus is an international, not-for-profit organisation registered in Singapore with an operational team based in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. Through carbon finance and impact investing, we support enterprises and projects working on clean energy, clean cooking, clean water, waste management, and climate resilience. As one of the early pioneers of carbon finance in the region, we help organisations navigate complex carbon markets and unlock the capital needed to scale their climate solutions, while our impact investing strategy provides SMEs and social enterprises with flexible, uncollateralised loans that help them scale their climate solutions to low-income communities. As a not-for-profit organisation, we’re not driven by shareholder returns; we prioritise ensuring that climate finance genuinely benefits the local enterprises, communities, and ecosystems behind the projects. Learn more at https://nexusfordevelopment.org POSITION DESCRIPTION We're looking for a Creative & Content Manager who turns complex ideas, like carbon finance and impact investment, into stories that make B2B audiences pay attention and start talking to us. You'll help lead Nexus's content planning from the first spark to the final report: pitching ideas in content development meetings, writing and producing them, and measuring what landed. Your audiences are sophisticated: project developers, carbon buyers, impact investors and partners, locally and globally. You know how to speak to them on LinkedIn, the website, in a pitch deck and in a printed brochure, and you know the difference. You keep a close eye on what's happening in marketing, from platform changes to new formats tools, and exciting creative campaigns and you bring that thinking back to the team. This is a creative lead role in a small team, so you'll also roll up your sleeves on wider marketing work when it's needed. investors, buyers and partners ·       Lead the content and design of brochures, one-pagers and other sales and communications assets, keeping them current and fresh ·       Produce static visuals and and brochures MEASURE AND IMPROVE ·       Track performance with analytics tools and report clearly on what's working against business goals ·       Turn insights into action: test formats, refine messaging and feed what you learn into the next round of planning STAY AHEAD AND PITCH IN ·       Keep up with marketing trends, B2B best practice, platform changes and new tools, including AI, and share what's relevant with the team ·       Support the Head of Marketing in maintaining the website alongside our agency ·       Help with wider marketing activity as needed, such as events, PR, partner communications and brand projects KEY REQUIREMENTS EXPERIENCE ·       3 to 4 years in content, creative or marketing communications, ideally in B2B, financial services, climate, impact or development ·       A strong understanding of B2B marketing: long decision cycles, multiple stakeholders, and content that builds trust and credibility ·       A portfolio that shows you've taken ideas from pitch to production to results ·       Hands-on experience writing for LinkedIn, pitch decks and brochures ·       A degree in communications, marketing, advertising or a related field, or ·       A team player who's happy to pitch in wherever marketing needs a hand WHAT WE OFFER : ·       Salary: 1400 – 1800 per month ·       Hybrid, flexible working, Monday to Friday ·       Training allowance and continuous professional development ·       40 days of holiday per year, including 10 public holidays ·       Visa and group health insurance ·       The chance to shape how a respected climate-finance organization tells its story POSITION SUMMARY Role Title: Creative & Content Manager Location: Phnom Penh, Cambodia Reporting to: Head of Marketing Schedule Full time, Monday to Friday review_candidates.description: Cost Lead Location: Johor, Malaysia Employment Type: Full-Time Industry: Construction / Data Centre / Industrial Projects Overview We are seeking an experienced Cost Lead to oversee all cost management activities across major construction projects in Johor. The successful candidate will be responsible for cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, contract administration, change management, and financial reporting throughout the project lifecycle. This role requires strong commercial acumen, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to lead cost control initiatives to ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets while maintaining high standards of quality and compliance. Key Responsibilities Cost Management & Commercial Control Lead project cost management activities from pre-construction through project completion. Develop and maintain project budgets, cost plans, forecasts, and cash flow projections. Monitor project expenditures and identify cost risks, opportunities, and variances. Provide accurate and timely cost reporting to project stakeholders and senior management. Establish cost control procedures and ensure compliance across project teams. Procurement & Contract Administration Support procurement activities, including tender evaluations, bid analysis, and contractor selection. Review and administer contracts to ensure commercial compliance. Assess contractor claims, progress payments, variations, and final accounts. Manage change control processes and evaluate the commercial impact of design and scope changes. Financial Reporting & Forecasting Prepare monthly cost reports, earned value analysis, and financial forecasts. Monitor commitments, accruals, and project cash flow. Provide recommendations to improve cost performance and project profitability. Ensure financial data integrity and reporting accuracy. Risk Management Identify and assess commercial and financial risks throughout the project lifecycle. Develop mitigation strategies to minimize cost overruns and contractual disputes. Support dispute resolution and commercial negotiations when required. Stakeholder Management Collaborate closely with project managers, engineers, consultants, contractors, and clients. Present cost status updates and recommendations to senior leadership. Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive project success. Team Leadership Lead and mentor Quantity Surveyors and Cost Engineers. Review work produced by the cost management team and ensure consistency of reporting and processes. Promote best practices in cost management and commercial administration. Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Cost Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 10+ years of experience in cost management, quantity surveying, or commercial management within construction projects. Proven experience managing large-scale projects such as data centres, industrial facilities, infrastructure, semiconductor, pharmaceutical, or mission-critical developments. Strong understanding of cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, procurement, and contract administration. Experience with FIDIC, PAM, NEC, or other standard forms of contract. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and cost management systems. Excellent analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications Professional membership with RICS, MRICS, AIQS, CIOB, or equivalent. Experience working in multinational consultancy, contractor, or client-side environments. Familiarity with data centre or hyperscale construction projects is highly desirable. Key Competencies Commercial Acumen Cost Control & Forecasting Contract Administration Financial Analysis Risk Management Negotiation Skills Leadership & Team Development Stakeholder Management Problem Solving Attention to Detail What We Offer Opportunity to work on high-profile construction and infrastructure projects. Exposure to large-scale data centre and mission-critical developments. Collaborative working environment. Career progression opportunities within a growing organization. Competitive salary and benefits package.
